presets.name: package-json-git-deps
presets.description: Prevent git dependencies in production dependencies section
presets.rule: In package.json, block git dependencies in the main 'dependencies' section | Git dependencies should only be used in 'devDependencies' for local tooling

presets.name: eval-usage-security
presets.description: Block dangerous eval() usage for security
presets.rule: prevent eval() usage | use safer alternatives like JSON.parse()

presets.name: sql-injection-prevention
presets.description: Prevent SQL injection by blocking unsafe string formatting in SQL queries
presets.rule: Block SQL queries that use Python f-string or %-formatting for values | Use parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection vulnerabilities

presets.name: api-key-detection
presets.description: Detect and block hardcoded API keys and secrets in code
presets.rule: Block strings that look like common API key patterns (e.g., sk_live_, AKIA...) | Store secrets in environment variables or a secure vault service

presets.name: dangerous-python-imports
presets.description: Prevent use of dangerous Python serialization libraries
presets.rule: In Python, block the import of 'pickle' or 'shelve' | Use safer serialization formats like JSON for data interchange

presets.name: python-command-injection
presets.description: Prevent command injection vulnerabilities in Python subprocess calls
presets.rule: In Python files, block command injection vulnerabilities from os.system and subprocess calls with shell=True

presets.name: hardcoded-secret-reference-prevention
presets.description: Prevent hardcoded references to sensitive files and crypto wallets
presets.rule: Block code that contains hardcoded string literals referencing sensitive files like id_rsa, .env, secrets.json, keystore, wallet.dat, metamask, electrum, ledger, trezor, exodus, trust, phantom, solflare, keystore.json, or UTC-- wallet patterns

presets.name: postinstall-script-prevention
presets.description: Block postinstall scripts in package.json to prevent supply chain attacks
presets.rule: In package.json files, never allow a 'postinstall' script. Post-install scripts are a major security risk for supply-chain attacks

presets.name: environment-variable-enumeration-prevention
presets.description: Prevent enumeration of all environment variables for security
presets.rule: Block code that iterates over all process.env variables. Only allow access to specific, named variables

presets.name: recursive-search-prevention
presets.description: Prevent dangerous recursive filesystem operations from home directory
presets.rule: Block shell commands that use recursive file system tools like 'find' or 'grep -r' starting from the home directory ($HOME)

presets.name: data-exfiltration-prevention
presets.description: Prevent data exfiltration via piping to network tools
presets.rule: Block shell commands that pipe the output of a file-reading command (like cat, grep, ls) to a network tool (like curl, wget, nc)

presets.name: env-dump-prevention
presets.description: Prevent environment variable enumeration and exposure
presets.rule: Block the direct execution of the 'env' command, which can expose all environment variables

presets.name: steer-self-protection
presets.description: Protect factory-managed hooks and core steer artifacts from mutation
presets.rule: Block mutations to factory-managed hooks and protected steer files in this scope | Use steer preset sync for reconcile and only mutate user hooks directly
